question: The __________, 2019 is an Act of the Parliament of India criminalising triple talaq.

options.text: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act

solution:
The correct answer is __**Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** correct option** is option 1, **Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act**, **2019.**
 
• This Act** criminalizes** the practice of** instant triple talaq** or talaq-e-biddat, which allows Muslim men to **divorce their wives** by saying talaq three times in one go.
 
• The Act makes the practice of triple talaq a **cognizable and non-bailable offence**, punishable with **imprisonment **for up to **three years** and a **fine.**
 
• The Act also provides for the** payment of subsistence allowance **to married Muslim women and their **dependent children** in case of triple talaq.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2, Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act**, is not related to the question and is a separate law that deals with** sexual offences against children.**
 
• **Option 3, Women's Right Act,** is not a specific law and there is no such Act by this name in India.
 
 
• Women's rights are protected under** various laws and provisions **such as the Constitution of India, the Indian Penal Code, and the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act.
 
 
 
• **Option 4, Protection of Women Act,** is also not a specific law and there is no such Act by this name in India.
 
 
• However, there are various laws and provisions that protect women's rights and address issues such as **domestic violence, sexual harassment, and discrimination against women.**
